FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.a1: Bayesian Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) uses PyMC to evaluate ad effectiveness by incorporating prior information and estimating non-linear saturation curves, rather than assuming linear responses.
FAQ.a2: Agent-Based Models (ABM) simulate the actions and interactions of autonomous customer agents to assess how advertising exposures diffuse via word-of-mouth and convert over time.
FAQ.q3: Does the system support offline mode?
FAQ.a3: Yes, for maximum privacy, the platform supports offline execution utilizing a local Ollama instance running Gemma 4.
FAQ.q4: How does GraphRAG prevent AI hallucinations?
FAQ.a4: GraphRAG retrieves exact facts from the Neo4j Knowledge Graph to feed into the LLM system prompt. The model is constrained to write reports based strictly on the retrieved mathematics.

bento.title: Solving 4 Structural Blind Spots
bento.subtitle: Traditional attribution models fail in walled gardens. Here is how BuniOS fixes it.
bento.spot1_desc: Uses Transfer Learning to estimate curves for new products with no historical data. Includes deep cross-industry metadata matching models to build high-accuracy estimations from the very first hour.
bento.spot2_desc: Applies Hill S-Curves to project the exact point where advertising yield diminishes. Computes half-saturation and saturation ceilings to optimize thresholds.
bento.spot3_desc: Models adstock memory retention and delay carries across consumer paths. Decays campaign effects over custom memory coefficients.
bento.spot4_desc: Aggregated Bayesian modeling replaces invasive third-party cookie tracking. Uses aggregate statistical models and Markov chains. Zero reliance on third-party cookies or intrusive mobile device trackers.

pipeline.title: The Simulation Pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: How the 6-layer engine processes data into actionable decisions.
pipeline.step1_desc: Crawls competitor pricing & promotions via Firecrawl.
pipeline.step2_desc: Isolates adstock delay and S-curve thresholds.
pipeline.step3_desc: Simulates customer conversions via Agent-Based Models.
pipeline.step5_desc: Retrieves contextual semantic graphs from Neo4j.
pipeline.step6_desc: Calculates SHAP contributions for clean reports.
pipeline.step1_canvas: Crawls competitor pages dynamically, bypasses bot detection mechanisms, and converts unstructured layouts into formatted analytical rows.
pipeline.step2_canvas: Estimates non-linear saturation curves and carries over ad awareness across days. Evaluates decay delay factors to isolate organic baselines.
pipeline.step3_canvas: Simulates discrete actions (word-of-mouth diffusion, coupon triggers, churn decisions) to evaluate how ad impressions scale exponentially in customer cohorts.
pipeline.step4_canvas: Runs multi-objective evolutionary calculations to output a Pareto curve. Resolves conflict boundaries between maximum ROAS yield and lowest risk variance.
pipeline.step5_canvas: Maps structural connections between variables, campaigns, and competitor nodes. Retains cross-market context to feed deterministic parameters to localized summaries.
pipeline.step6_canvas: Guarantees execution safety by proving feature impact coefficients. Eliminates model hallucination vectors for deterministic reports.
